question: At what points in the rite must an oblation be offered to Baṭuka?
premises: Baṭuka is the recipient of an oblation.
The offering is required at both beginning and end.
inference: One should offer an oblation to Baṭuka at the beginning and end of the rite.
plain_english: At the beginning and end of the rite, one should offer an oblation to Baṭuka.
